mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses corporate discount rates and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1300 and non-farm payrolls below 158000 indicate broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery, a core CPI decline below 310 indicates deflationary pressures, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances during post-shock recovery with CPIAUCSL < 310, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weak consumer demand, reducing construction activity and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous federal funds rate above 5.0% and core CPI decline below 310 during monetary tightening indicates aggressive policy in deflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a strong labor market (PAYEMS above 158000) signals overheating and imminent rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with PAYEMS > 158000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
